data.name: Description
data.value: The only folders Jarvis may read with its file tools. It reads them, and never writes in them. Everything else on this computer is refused, and each refusal is in the permission log.

data.name: FoldersHint
data.value: A folder gives access to everything under it. A link or a junction that points outside an allowed folder is refused.

data.name: None
data.value: No folder is allowed: Jarvis cannot read any file.

data.name: AddLabel
data.value: Path of a folder to allow

data.name: AddUnusable
data.value: Write the full path of a folder, with its drive.

data.name: SaveFailed
data.value: The settings could not be saved.

data.name: SizeHint
data.value: The most characters of a file or of a folder list given to the model in one call, from {0} to {1}. A longer file is read in several calls.
